entries.text: Do you have a room for two nights?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether a room is available for two nights.

entries.text: I have a reservation under the name Elena Rossi.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The reservation is under Elena Rossi's name.

entries.text: The shower in room 204 is not working.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The shower in room 204 does not work.

entries.text: Could you call a taxi from the hotel?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask the hotel to call a taxi.

entries.text: Could I have a table for two?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Request a restaurant table for two people.

entries.text: Please bring the bill when you have a moment.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Politely ask for the bill.

entries.text: Is the fish grilled or fried?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether the fish is grilled or fried.

entries.text: We ordered three coffees, not two.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Correct the order to three coffees rather than two.

entries.text: Does this train go to Naples?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether this train travels to Naples.

entries.text: I need two tickets for the 9:15 ferry.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Request two tickets for the ferry departing at 9:15.

entries.text: Is platform four on this side?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether platform four is on this side.

entries.text: Please tell me when we reach Sorrento.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask to be notified upon arrival in Sorrento.

entries.text: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask for directions to the nearest pharmacy.

entries.text: Turn left after the bridge, not before it.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Turn left after crossing the bridge, not before reaching it.

entries.text: Is the museum within walking distance?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether the museum can be reached on foot.

entries.text: Does the room cost 120 euros per night?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether the room rate is 120 euros for each night.

entries.text: Can I pay by card?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether card payment is accepted.

entries.text: I paid 50 euros, but the receipt says 15.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Report a discrepancy: payment was 50 euros, while the receipt shows 15 euros.

entries.text: Check-in is at 3:30 this afternoon.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Check-in is scheduled for 3:30 in the afternoon.

entries.text: Please wake me at six tomorrow morning.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Request a wake-up call at 6:00 tomorrow morning.

entries.text: Is the last bus still running tonight?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether the final bus service is operating tonight.

entries.text: Do not take the highway.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Instruct the driver to avoid the highway.

entries.text: I did not order wine.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: State that wine was not ordered.

entries.text: We cannot leave before Monday.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Leaving before Monday is not possible.

entries.text: I am allergic to peanuts.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: State a peanut allergy.

entries.text: Does this sauce contain shellfish?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether shellfish is an ingredient in the sauce.

entries.text: Please make it without cheese.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Request the dish with no cheese.

entries.text: Is this the bus for Piazza Navona?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether this bus goes to Piazza Navona.

entries.text: My name is Lucia Bianchi.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Introduce oneself as Lucia Bianchi.

entries.text: Please take us to Hotel Aurora.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask to be taken to Hotel Aurora.

entries.text: Avete una camera libera per tre notti?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether a room is available for three nights.

entries.text: La prenotazione è a nome di Marco Conti.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The reservation is under Marco Conti's name.

entries.text: L'ascensore non funziona al quarto piano.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The elevator on the fourth floor is not working.

entries.text: Potete chiamare un taxi per l'aeroporto?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask someone to call a taxi to the airport.

entries.text: Vorrei un tavolo per quattro persone.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Request a restaurant table for four people.

entries.text: Possiamo avere il conto, per favore?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Politely ask for the bill.

entries.text: Il pesce è alla griglia o fritto?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether the fish is grilled or fried.

entries.text: Abbiamo ordinato due pizze, non tre.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Correct the order to two pizzas rather than three.

entries.text: Questo treno ferma a Firenze?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether this train stops in Florence.

entries.text: Il traghetto parte dal molo sette alle otto e venti.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The ferry leaves from pier seven at 8:20.

entries.text: Serve un biglietto separato per il bambino?
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Ask whether a separate ticket is required for the child.

entries.text: Scendete alla prossima fermata.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Tell someone to get off at the next stop.

entries.text: La farmacia è dopo il ponte, sulla destra.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The pharmacy is past the bridge on the right.

entries.text: Non girate a sinistra qui.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Do not turn left here.

entries.text: Il museo è a cinque minuti a piedi.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The museum is a five-minute walk away.

entries.text: Il totale è di quarantadue euro e cinquanta.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The total is 42 euros and 50 cents.

entries.text: Accettiamo solo contanti.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Only cash payments are accepted.

entries.text: Il resto corretto è dieci euro, non uno.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The correct change is ten euros, not one euro.

entries.text: L'appuntamento è domani alle sette e un quarto.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The appointment is tomorrow at 7:15.

entries.text: La cucina chiude alle ventidue.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The kitchen closes at 22:00.

entries.text: Il primo autobus parte alle cinque del mattino.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The first bus departs at 5:00 in the morning.

entries.text: Non prendete questo autobus.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Do not take this bus.

entries.text: Il biglietto non è valido oggi.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The ticket is not valid today.

entries.text: Non possiamo entrare prima delle nove.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Entry before 9:00 is not permitted for us.

entries.text: Questo dolce contiene nocciole.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: This dessert contains hazelnuts.

entries.text: Non usiamo latte in questa ricetta.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: Milk is not used in this recipe.

entries.text: Il piatto è senza glutine, ma contiene uova.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The dish is gluten-free but contains eggs.

entries.text: Il conducente si chiama Gianni Ferraro.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The driver's name is Gianni Ferraro.

entries.text: La fermata è Piazza San Marco.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The stop is at Piazza San Marco.

entries.text: La prenotazione è per l'Hotel Bellavista.
entries.expectedMeaningEnglish: The reservation is for Hotel Bellavista.
